_source: ACKS Core Rulebook Dragon section + acore_monster_catalog_dragons.xml § dragon_attributes_by_habitat. Per-type curated special-abilities pools and elemental_aura damage types are project-designed (Phase 9C polish round 7 2026-05-09) to fit the RAW species descriptions while staying within the 13-ability list.
_note: Dragon-type lookup data. Resolver picks dragon TYPE at encounter time via terrain_to_dragon_type; type-specific data (hide colors, breath weapon, special abilities pool, alignment constraints, elemental_aura damage type) lives here. Per-instance state (selected hide_color, alignment, abilities, asleep state, can_speak) is rolled at encounter time and stored on the threat row's payload_json. The 10 dragon age-band catalog entries (dragon_spawn through dragon_venerable) hold age-only stats (HD, AC, damage, save, morale, XP, treasure_type, %_in_lair, spells_per_day_by_level, chance_asleep_pct, chance_speech_pct, special_abilities_count, encounter dice).
_terrain_to_dragon_type_note: Synthesized terrain_key (from HexTerrainQuery.synthesize_terrain_key) → weighted dragon-type pick. Weights are rough percentages; the resolver normalizes any sum (33+33+34=100; 67+33=100; etc.). The sentinel '__random_all_colors__' means re-roll uniformly across all 9 dragon types as a sub-roll. Sinkholes_of_evil and pinnacles_of_good are PoI/dungeon-stocker territory — wyrms and metallics are NOT in this terrain table; they spawn via PoI generators when those are built. Volcanic / glacier / arctic_mountains terrain types don't yet exist in hex_cells encoding (red and white live in 'mountains' for now); future polish will add those biomes and refine the mapping.
_lair_eligibility_note: Hills and clear are explicitly NOT lair-eligible per RAW intent (dragons there are passing through; no lingering / no settled-lair threat). Resolver forces is_lingering=false for these terrains regardless of the d100-vs-%-In-Lair check. Settled has no dragons at all.
_random_all_colors_note: The 9 dragon types eligible for the random_all_colors sub-roll. Excludes wyrm and metallic (those are PoI-only). Resolver picks uniformly across this list when the terrain weight points to '__random_all_colors__'.
_alignment_random_note: For dragon types without an alignment_constraint (red, blue, white, black, green, brown, sea), alignment is rolled uniformly across (lawful, neutral, chaotic) at encounter time. Wyrm forced chaotic; metallic forced lawful.
_offspring_note: RAW: 3+ dragons = mated pair (adult+) + offspring. Offspring are all from the same clutch (single age roll for the entire offspring batch). Roll uniformly across age bands STRICTLY YOUNGER than the parents' age band. Examples: Adult parents → offspring rolls one of [juvenile, young, very_young, spawn]; Mature Adult parents → one of [adult, juvenile, young, very_young, spawn]; Venerable parents → one of [ancient, very_old, ..., spawn]. All offspring in the encounter share the rolled age. All share the parents' dragon_type (a red mom doesn't have green babies) and alignment (chaotic family vs lawful family).
_spell_bias_note: Speakers (rolled per chance_speech_pct) cast arcane spells. Per RAW, charm_person (L1), invisibility (L2), mirror_image (L2), haste (L3) are favored. Picker: when the dragon has any L1 slots, ONE goes to charm_person; remaining L1 slots fill from random mage L1 spells in SpellRegistry. Same pattern for L2 (one to invisibility, then random; mirror_image takes the second slot if available — random covers L3+ when haste already placed). L4-L5 slots are pure random mage spells. The bias-favorite gets ONE slot per level when level matches; the rest are random (not all bias-favorites consume all slots).
